notes: 2026-10-13 review pass by reviewer: Pass. Checked the staged diff (102 files) against git diff --cached main. R-45 gate: pay-invoice.tsx:555 renders a step's body only while it is current and step 3 is current only when confirmed && method (pay-invoice.tsx:352), so the address and QR appear only after the network confirm, and Change network hides them again. R-51: canary-pay-page.ts:45-53 clicks every [data-method] choice (pay-invoice.tsx:333), reopening with [data-change] (pay-invoice.tsx:546), and reads each send step's addresses and QR paths; the only svg[role=img] in pay-send is the QrCode. The canary e2e passed (pay.spec.ts:235, e2e log line 54), and the fake page in canary_test.go goes through the same Change flow; go test -count=1 ./internal/canary/ ok. Money: the partly paid figure is pay.remaining (pay-invoice.tsx:211). The plain-decimal copy (pay-invoice.tsx:604) is safe because formatTokenAmount always groups with en-US. Money's group split and ActivityRow's single sign have tests (payments.test.tsx). Security: no new scripts on /pay (pay.spec.ts still checks script origins), no logging, and external links keep rel noopener (address.tsx, explorer-link.tsx). Structure: rows-skeleton is in shared/components with three unrelated consumers (activity, invoices, transactions); site-menu is in landing/layout; tooltip.test.tsx is in overlays/tests; groupSeries is at the feature top and has a test. Tests: pay.test.ts and the e2e edits follow intended copy and flow changes (aria-pressed to aria-current, tabs to choice cards), and none got weaker. Docs: DESIGN.md Checkout, R-45, R-54..R-67 and D-75..D-77 (queued as F129+), and design.json fw-pop-out and sheet transition match the code. Re-ran pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, web unit (79), ui-web unit (27) and check-docs: all pass. Non-blocking notes: (1) pay.ts:24 the PAY_STATES doc comment now sits above PAY_METHODS (pay.ts:26), so PAY_STATES has no doc and the first comment is orphaned. (2) No test covers the Left to pay figure, the Copy amount clipboard value, the stale banner, or Change network hiding the address again; worth an e2e. (3) Confirmed-as-plain-text markup is repeated in activity-row.tsx:63, invoice-deposits.tsx:56 and transactions-table.tsx:325 and could be one StatusPill variant. (4) pay-invoice.tsx is now 675 lines; Step, SendTo and ExactAmount could move to their own files if it grows. (5) Untracked package-lock.json and apps/backend/package-lock.json (Oct 11, not staged) should not be committed.
